description: Four-surface Linux-ABI measurement matrix for the pinned Asterinas release vs the node-stack footprint (runc/youki/containerd/kubelet). This is evidence scaffolding for founder decision F1(a); it does NOT claim Asterinas is the canonical node kernel.

claim_posture.evidence_role: Feeds the F1(a) kernel + pool-matrix ruling: published surface delta + G5 trigger evaluation. Availability values may remain unknown until QEMU probe receipts land.
claim_posture.g5_fallback: If cgroup v2 delegation, netlink, or overlayfs gaps persist as measured gaps (not merely unknown), Linux/Talos-class kernel stays the node kernel and Asterinas remains soak/boot evidence.

components_profiled.notes: Upper bound the owned executor must beat; profile via strace/seccomp under pinned ISO (QEMU).
Upper bound the owned executor must beat; differential oracle, never shipped default.
Go containerd CONSUME bootstrap footprint; product manager daemon is overruled — still profiled as node-stack reference.
Includes cAdvisor-class metrics and eviction paths that drive procfs/cgroupfs/statfs rows.

pool_matrix_notes.rationale: Asterinas is a TDX guest target and exposes no /dev/kvm. private-kernel and private-kernel-attested tiers therefore cannot schedule onto Asterinas pools.

linux_kvm_pools.notes: Stripped-Linux KVM host pools are a permanent SKU, not a fallback.

snapshotter_posture.notes: Overlayfs is required primarily on shared-kernel/Linux pools. On Asterinas, prefer the native snapshotter first; overlayfs edges remain High severity when the shared-kernel tier is in scope.

g5_trigger_definition.evaluation_rule: A G5-trigger row with available_on_asterinas_pin == gap (measured absence or non-enforcing) evaluates the G5 fallback. unknown does not fire G5; it keeps F1(a) blocked on measurement.

column_contract.required_by_node_stack: Closed list of node-stack consumers that need the surface (kubelet, cAdvisor, eviction, kube-proxy, CNI, runc/youki executor, containerd bootstrap).
column_contract.available_on_asterinas_pin: One of: present | gap | unknown. Scaffold defaults to unknown until the probe harness produces QEMU receipts against the pinned ISO.
column_contract.severity: One of: critical | high | medium | low.
column_contract.g5_trigger: Boolean. True iff a measured gap on this row is a G5 fallback trigger class (cgroup v2 delegation / netlink / overlayfs).

syscalls.description: Syscall families required by the node stack / OCI executor oracles. Not a raw syscall-count slogan — rows are named families or load-bearing calls.

rows.name: mount/umount2
rows.notes: Sandbox rootfs + bind mounts; pairs with mount_semantics surface.

rows.name: pivot_root
rows.notes: OCI rootfs isolation; also tracked under mount_semantics.

rows.name: seccomp (SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER)
rows.notes: Runtime seccomp profiles; measurement target for allowlist ratchet.

rows.name: bpf (cgroup device controller)
rows.notes: cgroup-v2 device controller needs eBPF; G5-adjacent to cgroup_v2_delegation fidelity.

proc_sys_cgroupfs.description: procfs/sysfs/cgroupfs file surfaces. cAdvisor and eviction paths are first-class — mountable ≠ enforcing.

rows.name: memory.current (cgroup v2)
rows.notes: cgroup v2 memory usage; G5 class cgroup_v2_delegation when absent or non-enforcing.

rows.name: cpu.stat (cgroup v2)
rows.notes: cgroup v2 CPU accounting; G5 class cgroup_v2_delegation.

rows.name: statfs (ephemeral-storage eviction)
rows.notes: kubelet eviction manager disk pressure signals.

netlink.description: Netlink families required for node networking. Critical risk: kube-proxy has no netfilter-free mode; ROUTE/LINK/ADDR are load-bearing.

rows.name: NETLINK_ROUTE (LINK)
rows.notes: Link create/set for veth/bridge; G5 class netlink.

rows.name: NETLINK_ROUTE (ADDR)
rows.notes: Address assignment on sandbox links; G5 class netlink.

rows.name: netfilter / nftables netlink
rows.notes: kube-proxy has no netfilter-free mode; measured gap here is a hard G5 signal.

mount_semantics.description: Mount propagation and overlay semantics. Overlayfs is primarily required on shared-kernel/Linux pools; Asterinas prefers native snapshotter first.

rows.name: MS_SHARED mount propagation
rows.notes: Propagation setup for nested mounts / kubelet volume plumbing.

rows.name: MS_SLAVE mount propagation
rows.notes: Sandbox mount isolation relative to host.

rows.name: overlayfs whiteouts / xattrs
rows.notes: G5 class overlayfs when shared-kernel/Linux pools require overlay snapshotter. Asterinas pools: native snapshotter first — this row remains tracked for shared-kernel fidelity.

rows.name: pivot_root semantics
rows.notes: Cross-listed with syscalls; mount-namespace correctness after pivot.

measured_today: four surfaces present with required columns
